title: Blue Marble: Next Generation with Topography and Bathymetry, April 2004
purpose: Historical natural-surface colour basemap for geographic orientation; not current land cover, crop distribution, suitability, observed weather, or a height map.
credits: NASA Earth Observatory; Blue Marble: Next Generation produced by Reto Stoeckli, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Dataset paper: R. Stoeckli, E. Vermote, N. Saleous, R. Simmon and D. Herring (2005).

processing.operation: Uniform image resize and JPEG recompression only

georeferencing.verifiedBy: BMNG dataset user manual sections 5.1 and 5.2, global 8km extent; downloaded image visually checked

license.basis: NASA-produced educational/informational imagery, used with source acknowledgement under NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines. The project requests credit NASA Earth Observatory. Do not imply NASA endorsement; this asset contains no NASA logo or identifiable person.

limits: Historical monthly composite from 2004, not real-time satellite imagery or present vegetation.
Relief and bathymetry are precomputed image shading, not a displacement/elevation texture.
Approximate 8km source sampling at equator; displayed 4096px derivative does not increase geographic resolution.
Cloud/snow compositing and reprojection artifacts remain possible; coarse vector coastlines will not match every coastal pixel.
Use a separate data-colour view or legible data overlays; image colours are not a statistical legend.

integration.canvasDraw: ctx.drawImage(image,0,0,2880,1440) before vector borders and teaching overlays
integration.sphereAlignment: Keep the same existing CanvasTexture/SphereGeometry UV convention already used by the d3 equirectangular texture. Do not separately rotate the raster.
integration.fallback: Keep the original flat basemap if decode or 2:1 validation fails.
integration.offline: Embed only the runtime JPEG at its literal path; original source is retained for provenance and is not required at runtime.
